contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DIVO C CO[--] ; R/ [SPES REI PVBLICE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), Emperor right with globe, possibly irregular later Roman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head helmeted or veiled right, large eye. Obverse inscription: DIVO C CO[--]. Reverse description: Emperor in military dress standing right holding globe and vertical spear. X in left field. Illegible trace of mintmark in exergue. Reverse inscription: [SPES REI PVBLICE]. Diameter: 13.3mm, Weight: 1.24gms, die axis: 12
